name: RSI handles flat prices correctly
description:
Verifies RSI behavior when prices don't move (flat market).
    
    Expected behavior:
    - RSI should return 50 (neutral) for flat prices
    - This indicates no momentum in either direction
    
    Why this matters:
    - Flat prices mean no gains or losses
    - RSI should reflect neutral market condition
    - Prevents false signals in sideways markets
